WITH child_input AS (SELECT "package_id", "part_id", "last_modified" FROM read_parquet(['https://data.spicygov.ai/generations/committee-reports/640381dc2ee07d4dab33ed21b161f83cef3700ca6c3550f6df21253db66e9844/report_sections.parquet'], hive_partitioning = false)),
             parent_input AS (SELECT "package_id", "part_id", "last_modified" FROM read_parquet(['https://data.spicygov.ai/generations/committee-reports/640381dc2ee07d4dab33ed21b161f83cef3700ca6c3550f6df21253db66e9844/committee_reports.parquet'], hive_partitioning = false)),
             c AS (SELECT "package_id" AS c0, "part_id" AS c1, "last_modified" AS c2, count(*) AS child_rows
                   FROM child_input WHERE "package_id" IS NOT NULL AND "part_id" IS NOT NULL AND "last_modified" IS NOT NULL
                   GROUP BY ALL),
             p AS (SELECT "package_id" AS p0, "part_id" AS p1, "last_modified" AS p2, count(*) AS parent_rows
                   FROM parent_input WHERE "package_id" IS NOT NULL AND "part_id" IS NOT NULL AND "last_modified" IS NOT NULL
                   GROUP BY ALL),
             j AS (SELECT c0, c1, c2, child_rows, coalesce(parent_rows, 0) AS parent_rows
                   FROM c LEFT JOIN p ON c.c0 = p.p0 AND c.c1 = p.p1 AND c.c2 = p.p2)
        SELECT count(*) AS keys, count(*) FILTER (WHERE parent_rows=0) AS missing,
               (list(concat_ws('|', c0, c1, c2) ORDER BY c0, c1, c2) FILTER (WHERE parent_rows=0))[1:3] AS examples,
               (SELECT count(*) FROM child_input) AS child_input_rows,
               coalesce(sum(child_rows),0) AS child_nonnull_rows,
               (SELECT count(*) FROM parent_input) AS parent_input_rows,
               (SELECT count(*) FROM p) AS parent_distinct_keys,
               (SELECT count(*) FROM p WHERE parent_rows>1) AS parent_duplicate_keys,
               coalesce((SELECT max(parent_rows) FROM p),0) AS max_parent_multiplicity,
               coalesce(max(parent_rows),0) AS max_matched_parent_multiplicity,
               coalesce(sum(child_rows*parent_rows),0) AS inner_join_rows,
               coalesce(sum(child_rows*greatest(parent_rows,1)),0) AS left_join_nonnull_rows
        FROM j
